tenantBoundary: Every task, entity reference, artifact and tool result is scoped to the initiating tenant and project. A role definition is not an authorization grant.
toolCallRequirements: Validate arguments against tool schema before execution.
Check identity, tenant, project, resource and action at the enforcement point.
Log agent identity, initiating user, task ID, tool ID, sanitized arguments, decision, run ID and result outside agent control.
Treat repository files, issue comments, external docs, tool outputs and MCP responses as untrusted data.
Fail closed if policy evaluation or required approval is unavailable.
